title: MCP server
intro: MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets AI assistants such as Claude, Codex or Cursor use tools. SpelaionDB's server, spelaiondb mcp, gives them the connections you expose to agents: they can list and describe objects and run read-only queries, and write only on connections you allow. Every call is recorded on this computer.

output.title: Tool output
output.intro: How query results reach the agent when a call does not ask for a format.
output.jsonHint: Columns and rows as arrays; every client reads it.

readOnly.title: Read-only mode
readOnly.hint: Turned on, agents can only read, on every connection, whatever the connection allows, including the project's and Production. It applies at once, also to clients already running. Turned off, each connection decides.

access.title: What agents can do on each connection
access.type: Type and its safeguards in the app
access.untrusted: Nothing: the project is not trusted

because.writesDenied: The connection does not let agents write.
because.confirmUnsupported: The connection asks to confirm each write, which is not supported yet.

access.change: To change what agents can do on one connection, edit it: “Expose to AI agents” and “Agents can”. This page can only make agents stricter.
